name: UF-style-dark
note: dark — gritty, muted, ominous. Wide 320x180 scene in the model's own colors. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 0. Twin of FACTORY/style-dark.  (sample: seed 1433)

form.subject: an (abandoned village street:1.3) at dusk, a (broken cart:1.2), boarded-up houses
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (user interface, hud, health bar:1.2), border

sample_command: pixelmon 'an (abandoned village street:1.3) at dusk, a (broken cart:1.2), boarded-up houses' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora pixel-art-xl.safetensors --lora-strength 1 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (user interface, hud, health bar:1.2), border' --style dark,scene --out 320x180 --palette none --despeckle 0 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --seed 1433
